dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Killi (Idlib District), Syria as of 16 February 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code EQ20230206SYR, GDACS Id: 1357372** This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by the 6th of February 2023 earthquake in Killi in Idlib district (Aleppo governorate), Syria as detected from a Pleiades very highresolution satellite image acquired on 16 February 2023. UNOSAT 11 potentially damaged structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
